== Description ==
'''D-55''' is an entity that can check hiding spots (see Behavior). It looks like a thing without any eye, only a mouth full of teeth rotated diagonally.

== Behavior ==
When '''D-55''' spawns, it will start rushing to the current room at high speeds, it emits a loud sound that can be heard from far away. After it has reached the current room, it will start destroying any Heavy lockers/Supply cabinets in the most recently generated rooms (All rooms that were generated while '''D-55''' is rushing, will be counted and '''D-55''' will destroy all determinated hiding spots in those rooms).

After it is done destroying Supply Cabinets/Heavy Lockers, it will retreat at slower speeds. After it has reached the point where it spawned, it will despawn.

If it finds a player, that player will instantly die.

==Strategy & Tips==
* When you hear '''D-55'''<nowiki/>'s sound, look for a White Cabinet/Blue Heavy Locker ('''D-55''' takes a while to reach the current room). If you can't find them, go to the previous room and find any hiding spot there (if you didn't open any doors during<nowiki/> D-55's presence). If you can't do both, open the next door, and look for a White Cabinet/Blue Heavy Locker. If you don't find anything, well, you're dead.
* When [[D-60i]] is spawned, [[D-140]] can't spawn, so always prefer to hide in Blue heavy lockers/White cabinets when [[D-60i]] is active.
* Other entities can mask '''D-55'''<nowiki/>'s sound cue so stay alert if noisy entities are present or aproaching your room
* '''D-55''' can be avoided by hidin<nowiki/>g on fridges or green lockers

== Trivia ==
*'''D-55's''' name, Motormouth, is because of the motor like sound he m<nowiki/>akes while approaching.
* '''D-55''', [[D-5]], and [[M-134]] are the only naturally spawning entities from '''OG RFF''' that haven't gotten their Designs changed since they were first released
